month_summary: July 1916: Somme offensive begins with catastrophic British losses on July 1st - 57,470 casualties including 19,240 dead. Grinding attritional warfare follows with limited gains at Fricourt, La Boisselle, Mametz, and Contalmaison. Meanwhile, Russian Brusilov offensive continues in east with battles at Berestechko, Baranovichi, and Kowel. Disaster strikes Australians at Fromelles with 5,533 casualties. Month establishes pattern of massive losses for minimal territorial gains that will define remainder of war.
